sections.markdown:
## A — Exam authority, Section Ten Turning and parking

This dossier supports first-time, never-licensed applicants preparing for the West Virginia Class E knowledge examination. The issuing authority is the West Virginia Division of Motor Vehicles within the West Virginia Department of Transportation, and the source is the current revised edition of the West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook pinned in the run configuration. The registrar verified no official question count, passing score, test format or time limit for the knowledge examination, so this dossier asserts no value for any of them. The handbook's own examination chapter describes a question minimum and a passing line in its text; those lines travel only as cited knowledge facts in the knowledge-examination section of this run, never as verified exam facts. Practice scoring follows only the accepted LearningLoop product policy. Section Ten covers the turning procedure and left-turn cautions, turning on red, where turning around is illegal, how to back up, general parking duties, the list of prohibited stopping and parking places with their distances, angle parking, parking on hills, metered parking, parallel parking step by step, and the following-distance counting rule.

corpus_stability.reason: The West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook is a periodically revised official edition, so the Section Ten Turning and parking content changes at most with a new edition.
